notes.title: Quartet arrives to Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[h1]QUARTET ARRIVES TO KICKSTARTER[/h1]
[h2]Classic turn-based indie RPG with tag-team mechanics [/h2]

[b]September 1st, 2021[/b]: Quartet, the second retro-inspired JRPG from games studio Something Classic, is live on Kickstarter now until September 30th, 2021.  A spiritual successor to Something Classic’s 2017 release, Shadows of Adam, Quartet lets players control eight characters across four stories that gradually merge into one epic quest.  Backers on Kickstarter can opt into a variety of rewards, from copies of the game to higher-level rewards like the chance to design epic gear, craft an NPC, or even write a whole quest!  Join the campaign: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0[/url]

[i]“Shadows of Adam was a success for us,” [/i]says producer Tyler Mire.  [i]“But we learned so much from the experience and the user feedback. We’ve put everything we’ve learned into Quartet to make it so much bigger and better than our last game.”[/i]

From the steampunk-inspired streets of Leornia, to the airship battles that rage on the battlefront of the Auslen Empire, Quartet takes players on an adventure they will never forget!  Meet a remarkable cast of characters including a snooty mage, a disillusioned soldier, an irreverent cook, a troubled shop girl, a sentient water mammal, a dashing doctor, a magical cop, and an ancient golem.  Collect oodles of powerful gear for your small army of protagonists, while unraveling an ancient conspiracy that literally reshaped the world centuries ago.

[b]Features include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Eight heroes with a unique roster of spells and abilities
[*] Tactically deep tag-team combat
[*] A sprawling, character-driven story
[*] Tons of epic and imaginative loot
[/list]

[b]ABOUT QUARTET[/b]
Quartet begins with four separate chapters, playable in any order.  In those four chapters, players meet eight unlikely heroes, and get to see how the stories intertwine into an epic narrative surrounding the war over the control of magic.  In battle, players deploy four characters at any time, with the ability to instantly swap the other four characters in, tag-team style.

[b]ABOUT SOMETHING CLASSIC[/b]
Something Classic is an indie studio with a passion for modern takes on the classic JRPG genre.  Their previous game, Shadows of Adam, was a cult hit among retro JRPG enthusiasts and is available on Steam, Nintendo Switch and Sony Playstation 4.

Quartet is on Kickstarter from September 1st 2021 through September 30th 2021 at [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0[/url]

[url=press.somethingclassic.net/sheet.php?p=quartet]PRESS KIT[/url]

notes.title: Pillars of Dust Demo coming August 31st!
notes.content:
Something Classic Games is excited to publish Retreaux Game’s exciting new retro jrpg, Pillars of Dust. Here’s some information about the upcoming demo!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/7fc0af19f90c6cef0434f913360c118aa47e36f8.png[/img]

[u][b]August 31 is demo release day[/b][/u]

We will be releasing a playable demo of Pillars of Dust on [i][b]August 31, 2019[/b][/i]. We spent some time incorporating the feedback we received at Replay FX into the game, and we think you will like the results. As an example of something that we adjusted, we made movement smoother – while retaining the speed.

The demo will let you play all the way through to the end of the first dungeon for each main character, Carlton and Gregg. It’s a pretty decent slice of the total game, and it will be jam-packed with secrets for the savvy explorer.

[u][b]Visit our Steam page[/b][/u]

We have created a Steam page for Pillars of Dust, which will go live on August 31. When we release the full game, it will be available on Steam for download. But starting August 31, you can start adding Pillars of Dust to your Steam wishlist so you’ll know exactly when it’s released – and when it goes on sale!

[u][b]Reach out on social media[/b][/u]

As always, we welcome feedback – don’t hesitate to reach to us on social media if you have any questions, comments, or just want to chat. Here are some ways to reach us:
[list]
[*]   [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/somethingclassic]Something Classic Discord[/url]

[*]   Use the hashtag #PillarsOfDust 
[/list]

That’s all for now. Watch out for the next announcement on August 31!

Keep it retreaux,

Josh and Andy

notes.title: Something Classic Games announces TWO new projects!
notes.content:
Something Classic Games is thrilled to announce the production of two new exciting JRPGs: Quartet and Pillars of Dust. Spearheaded by members from the Shadows of Adam development team, the games will also be developed with new outside collaborators.
 
[u][b]Pillars of Dust:[/b][/u]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/7fc0af19f90c6cef0434f913360c118aa47e36f8.png[/img]

Josh Garlitz (programmer and developer of Shadows of Adam) and Andrew Steadman bring together a JRPG with an arcade feel. Speed through the game as two men on an intersecting quest, or take the time to explore and learn about the storied past of the once prosperous nation of Alluriga. Grinding and repetition take a backseat to exploration, bizarre characters, and jokes about wimpy hands.
 
[b]FEATURES[/b]
   [list]
[*]  Two main quest lines that come together 
[*]     SELECT which order you want to complete the game in: play through one character’s entire arc before starting the other’s. Choose carefully: the order you play in will confer advantages to the other character!
[*]     Unique dialogue and world building: exploration and talking to everyone and everything will be worth your while
[*]     Keep track of your progress as you try to earn the legendary 100% completion
[*]     In game currency is chicken nuggets
[/list]

Pillars of Dust is aiming for a Q1 2020 release on PC. Follow its development on [url=https://twitter.com/retreauxgames?fbclid=IwAR2WbEj7DbOrBL4itGNQ8u-5saTT0vcTe4_IilLAy0cRzusjxzAG46-oNeQ]twitter[/url].
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/367d5f50e430d982caa3399298ac46c057c2f73e.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/086ba86611c578188cb2a469157e4a820764a4b9.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Quartet:[/b][/u]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/630d4c9bb3c9d41a6db81a486772bdba3411e64e.png[/img]

Quartet is a new JRPG from Shadows of Adam producer/composer Tyler Mire, with original character art from Shadows of Adam lead artist, Tim Wendorf, and writing and systems design from Patrick Holleman, author of the [i]Reverse Design[/i] series. 
 
Eight heroes from four very different backgrounds come together to end the war for the control of magic. Along the way, they discover the secret history that shaped their world in unimaginable ways.
 
[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*]     Eight diverse protagonist characters
[*]     Story-driven campaign
[*]     Four separate opening chapters than can be played in any order
[*]     Deep combat system featuring eight-character swap-in/swap-out   combat
[*]     Multi-party puzzle dungeons to explore
[*]     Loads of secret items you can use to break the game
[/list]

Quartet's release window and targeted platforms will be announced in the future.

We will be releasing more information about these games, including individual character showcases for Quartet, so please follow us on twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/SomethingClassc]@somethingclassc[/url]

Or join our awesome community over at [url=http://www.discord.gg/somethingclassic]discord[/url]

notes.title: The Shadows of Adam - Official Players Guide is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hi all,

It's been quite a while since our last update and I hope this finds you well. For those who backed at the $35 tier or higher, you should have received the Official Player's Guide in your Humble Bundle.

It is also available on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037860/Shadows_of_Adam__The_Official_Players_Guide/

The Shadows of Adam - The Official Player's Guide is comprised of 60 full-color pages, complete with boss strategies, item tables, fabled secrets and full area maps. No Shadows of Adam collection is complete without this Official Player's Guide!

[list]
[*] Area Maps - Detailed maps with tons of callouts to treasure, interesting NPCs and even secret paths!
[*] Boss Strategies - Detailed boss strategies written by the developers and members of the Shadows of Adam community to help take your game to the next level.
[*] Weapon, Armor and Item Tables - Crunchy data on all of the equipment available in Shadows of Adam!
[*] Bestiary - Tables containing monster data for all enemies in Shadows of Adam!
[*] Puzzle Solutions - Puzzle solutions in video form, so you will never get stuck!
[/list]

Further, we have also updated the OST Package to include the new DLC tracks and the new Nintendo Switch remaster mixes.

[h1]Wait, what? The Nintendo Switch?![/h1]
That's right! Shadows of Adam will be making an appearance on the Nintendo Switch! We will be making an announcement [i]VERY[/i] soon!

Thank you for all the support!


- The Something Classic Team

notes.title: Version 1.1.1/1.0.4 update
notes.content:
Hello all,

We have a new update that contains a few fixes and QoL updates. Please let us know if there are any issues:

[b]V 1.1.1 Fixes[/b]
-Remove "evasionBonus" from Nik1 and Harpy (Wind Tower). Oversight.
-Fix clip in Passageway.
-Fix clip in Final Dungeon.
-Fixed occasional teleport bug when going from Borges to Pirate cave at end game.
-Replace Rat ambush battle in Borges with stationary battle to prevent rare softlock.
-Moraga's (Water Guardian) "Attune" spell is slightly buffer.
-Add two way teleporter in the Final Dungeon. Once activated in final corridor, you can freely teleport back and forth from beginning to end.

[b]Guild of the Artificers V 1.0.4[/b]
-Remove potential softlock when traveling to guild from an inn keeper.
-Fixed collision and graphical issue with statue near entrance of the DLC dungeon.
-Fixed crash that occurred when running game directly from .exe and DLC achievement is activated.

Exciting speedrunning news, two new WRs have been posted for Shadows of Adam:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.speedrun.com/Shadows_of_Adam/run/ywp184pz]Any % WR - Dowolf in 3:06:14[/url]
[*][url=https://www.speedrun.com/Shadows_of_Adam/run/y6p753jm]Pirate % WR - WicKedGamerDude in 49:15[/url]
[/list]

In addition, we have a discord which has become quite active in the recent weeks. If you're a fan of SoA, a potential speedrunner or just wanna find a cool place to hang and talk about games please join us: [url=https://discord.gg/P3bgBRc]Shadows of Adam Discord[/url]

Stay tuned for more updates as we finish up the Player's Guide and other exciting things to come. 

All the best,
Ty, Tyler, Josh, Tim, and Luke

notes.title: “Guild of the Artificers” DLC Expansion released!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We are super excited to release our DLC expansion, Shadows of Adam: Guild of the Artificers ([url=store.steampowered.com/app/663820/Shadows_of_Adam__Guild_of_the_Artificers/]STEAM[/url]). Please enjoy it with a 16% launch discount! In addition, we are unveiling a Shadows of Adam Deluxe Edition Bundle, where you can pick up both Shadows of Adam and the expansion [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5095/Shadows_of_Adam_Deluxe_Edition/]on Steam[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e6VPe7U.png[/img]

Shadows of Adam: Guild of the Artificers at a glance:
[list]
[*] New Game Plus Mode - Replay the game with all end game equipment and artifacts, but at level 1. All monsters get a buff to their power. Can you survive? (Note: To unlock NGP you must first beat the game and it will unlock after the credits finish).
[*] Battle Arena - Fight thrilling gauntlets of battles for rare and awesome rewards!
[*] Artifact Crafting - Combine and craft your own unique artifacts. Mix and match your favorites to create the ultimate combination!
[*] Black Market - Buy powerful items from the world's most illustrious shopkeepers!
[*] Mystic Caverns - Legend says there is a mystical cave that holds some of the greatest treasure of all mankind. Be warned, monsters and puzzles of unfathomable power await you!
[*] Higher Level Cap - Reach new heights with an extended level cap of 50. Demonstrate your prowess to unlock a high-level skill for each of the four heroes.
[*] New Bosses - Take on 3 epic bosses designed to test the limits of your battle-hardened mettle.
[*] New Achievements - Over 10 new achievements to unlock!
[/list]

In addition a few streamers will be showcasing the DLC throughout the day. Please check out these awesome folks!

Overlordbossk - https://go.twitch.tv/overlordbossk
Azure - https://go.twitch.tv/azureseishin
Absnerdity - https://go.twitch.tv/absnerdity
Webster - https://go.twitch.tv/webster

In addition we pushed a main game update, with just a few small fixes:

[b]Changelist for 1.0.8:[/b]
- Fix crash involving Curse + Wraith Charm
- Pendragos missing Weak State graphic added

Please enjoy the game! If you share the game with friends on social media please use the hashtags #ShadowsOfAdam and #SoADLC!

All the best,
Ty, Tyler, Josh, Tim, and Luke

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 patch now out!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We have a new patch out which includes mostly small QoL and a few fixes.

A big discovery is something that will help all those who have tried streaming with OBS or use a Steam Controller.

If you are using Windows 10, right-click the "Shadows of Adam.exe" executable. Click the 'Compatibility' tab and run the game with Windows 8 compatibility. That should keep the Steam Controller working consistently and allow you to capture SoA with a "Window Capture".

https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=1&v=bjmX7NdJX8w

This might be a potential fix for Steam Link/in-home streaming issues as well. If someone could try this and let us know, we'd appreciate it!


[b]V 1.0.7 Fixes[/b]

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Support for left analog stick on controllers
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Warfist had wrong accuracy buff assigned. Typo in description fixed.
[*]Sell menu has 10s digit toggling and added SFXs.
[*]Elixir no longer removes positive status such as "Double-Up" or "Blur"
[*]Menu now displays description of currently equipped equipment.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/2592ce51b9ca871f8be75802e99c924bc358453f.png[/img]
 
[*]Health now renamed to Health Ring 
[*]Added 48 hidden stat boost Juices to find! 40 are non miss-able. Look for in barrels, boxes and shelves. New achievement tied to finding 40 in the world!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/a796e4f87ca992ef4f079da2c36d11a1e8986d9e.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/b423b25235f90acab75a3102ff5e22951bdb024a.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/691b63b9f05d1fc287999cfe49f200b04c4edf1b.png[/img]

[*]Better Equipment menu toggling (left/right) to get to items at bottom of list quicker.
[*]Misc shop menu fixes
[*]Fix Wraith Charm rounding issues
[*]Steam Achievements now correctly displaying 
[/list]


[b]Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*]Pick a Card got a 7% power buff
[*]Pick a Card now has a Lightning Card. Big, single target damage.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/77214a28a12282494e66e2be88014862d2c8950f.png[/img]

Remember our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/506510/announcements/detail/1493365108988264013]DLC[/url] is releasing Oct 24th so stay tuned!

All the best,
Ty, Tyler, Josh, Tim, and Luke

If you are using Windows 10, right-click the "Shadows of Adam.exe" executable. Click the 'Compatibility' tab and run the game with Windows 8 compatibility. That should keep the Steam Controller working consistently and allow you to capture SoA with a "Window Capture".

https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=1&v=bjmX7NdJX8w

This might be a potential fix for Steam Link/in-home streaming issues as well. If someone could try this and let us know, we'd appreciate it!

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 patch now out - upcoming DLC and new achievements!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've just pushed a new update/patch. It is mostly QOL fixes with some misc bug fixes and tweaks. 

Change List - V 1.0.6

Fixes:

-Typo fixes.
-Collision fixes.
-Crash Fix: Fixed 'Black Screen on game start'
-Fix AP glitch where AP pool doubles after level up when wearing Wraith Band, Wraith Bracelet or Wraith Ring.
-Golem boss' counter attacks correctly assigned to Earth elemental.
-Fix misassigned weakness in ZaknNik Magma sanctum fight
-Fix glitch where when Blur expired, magic evasion and speed buffs weren't being reset.
-Fix scene specific issues where music would replay in some instances after fading out.
-Allow player to return to Earth Cave after completing area.
-Correctly reset Water Garden water levels when you re-enter, to allow player to explore once completed.
-Fix text width limit in selling menu.
-Fix cursor issue in main item menu when toggling left to right.

Tweaks:

-Increase Taunt chance to 85% from 80%. 
-Taunt now can remove Blur from enemies.

Graphics:

-Cave entrance/exits are clearer.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/2f11afc232c21fe507a26b3b3e7baf6f7c380f9d.jpg[/img]

Possible story spoiler:
[spoiler]
-Airship staircase tweak.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501231/7e0c9e36940a2de2e537d83804d50981735031ce.jpg[/img]
[/spoiler]

In addition, we are hard at work on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/506510/announcements/detail/1327847267559808380]DLC[/url]. We will hopefully have another update shortly with more info. You may notice new achievements that players will be able unlock in the DLC. The wait isn't too much longer!

Thanks for all your support and please leave us a message with any feedback or suggestions you may have. It helps us continually improve the experience for you all.

All the best,
Ty, Tyler, Josh, Tim, and Luke

notes.title: Patch - Version 1.0.4. and OST now available!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Patch 1.0.4 is now out. It mainly addresses some edge case bugs that have been reported with some small tweaks to improve experience.

In addition, the Shadows of Adam OST is now available for purchase from Steam! You can get that here: [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/604430/]Shadows of Adam OST[/url]

Change List - V. 1.0.4.

Fixes:

-Fix issue with rare teleport bug into Firmus from worldmap.
-Add reset switch to Airship barrel puzzle to prevent potential soft lock.
-Collision fix in Airship.
-Collision/Softlock fix in Dradora upper left corner post Airship.
-Fix for rare bug where artifact bonuses aren't applied on level ups.
-Typo fix in flashback scene.
-Fix where you could win dice game in Dradora and it would disable Pendragos fight.
-Fixed graphical error with past Curtis' left moving frames.
-Fixed graphical error with south moving Kellan riding mindcart

Tweaks:

-Thunder and Star Rod swapped in locations. Relative stats are identical.
-Crystal sword gets +10 SPD bonus to better balance with Kellan's late game swords.
-Misc music tweaks

All the best,
Ty, Tyler, Josh, Tim, and Luke

notes.title: Patch - Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've pushed a patch to fix some bugs and some other areas of improvement based on user feedback.

Change-list V 1.0.3

[b]Fixes:[/b]
-Steam Cloud Support now working.
-Fixed bug where enemy disappears in battle after killing it but keeps attacking, sometimes causing a crash. 
-Music looping improved.
-LUK display glitch with Gambler armor. 
-Statues in Water Garden can't go over water (oversight).
-Fix to soft lock in Water Garden puzzle.
-Teleporter orbs can not go into edges of maps anymore.
-Airship collision fix.
-Typo fixes.

[b]Tweaks:[/b]
-Mind Read says "Resistance" instead of "Immunities".
-Mind Read text is now a second shorter.
-Taunt now costs 30 AP and has an 80% chance to hit.
-Late game bosses now have Taunt resistance (oversight).
-Moraga no longer has "Sudden Death" move. Reworked AI and skills.
-Wind Tower "Save" is moved in front of boss door.
-Water Garden "Save" is moved in main path, so he can't be skipped.
-Final Boss received a small buff in the last form of combat. 

Thanks for the great first week! We've been thrilled with the wonderful feedback and reception from you all.

All the best,
Ty, Tyler, Josh, Tim, and Luke
